# Component Standards

Use this skill to answer component design and implementation questions.

## Trigger Signals

- User asks for guidance on button, table, form, card, dialog, layout, navigation, router, or API design patterns.
- Request is instructional rather than immediate project generation.

## Workflow

1. Read [references/components-index.md](references/components-index.md).
2. Load only relevant component guide files.
3. Answer with concrete examples and concise best practices.
4. Keep recommendations aligned with repository standards.
